title: GPOM MV Ending Clips
heading: The ending, animated: 19 clips
intro: Each clip is 8 seconds; you'll use 2–5 seconds of each in Premiere. Tap Keep on the ones you're happy with; for anything else, write the re-roll in that clip's note. Amber lines are what I saw when checking.

sections.h: The last shot: Earth from the Moon, animated
sections.lede: Your still b, three moves asked for, six takes back. Labels say what each actually does.

groups.title: 20. Earth over the Moon: the final shot
groups.line: After the 18 pull-back. Tip: any push-in can be played BACKWARDS in Premiere to become a pull-away that ends on Earth over the Moon.

opts.label: d: camera rises, the Moon sinks away, Earth hangs alone in black
opts.warn: Earthrise in reverse; ends on Earth alone with a sliver of Moon.

opts.label: b: steady push in, Earth grows to fill the frame, stays framed
opts.warn: Cleanest push-in. Reversed = a pull-away to finish on.

opts.label: c: push in, Moon drops out of frame, continents fill the middle
a: fastest push in; Earth ends cropped at the right edge
opts.warn: Earth runs off the right edge in the last second.

opts.label: e: locked, Earth slowly turns over the Moon
opts.warn: Subtle; the quiet ending.

opts.label: f: locked, nearly still
opts.warn: Held frame, good under a fade.

sections.lede: 17: the satellite holds and the Earth moves. 18: your zoom-out with one satellite. 20: a planet you can tell is Earth (stills first; I animate the one you pick).

groups.title: 17. The satellite over Europe: Earth moves, satellite holds
groups.line: Your note: 'we shouldn't see the satellite rotate, we should see the earth move underneath it.'

opts.label: r2: satellite holds dead still, Earth turns beneath it
opts.warn: Best fit to your note. Europe's red fades into cloud after ~4s as the Atlantic rolls in; cut around 4s.

opts.label: p2: Europe slides past, stays red all 8s (no satellite yet)
opts.warn: Earth only, from a clean plate: the still satellite would be laid on top in post. Storm swirls in at ~6s.

opts.label: p3: slow gentle drift, Europe red throughout (no satellite yet)
opts.warn: Earth only; satellite laid on top in post. Calmest of the three.

opts.label: p1: Earth turns fast into daylight over the Sahara (no satellite yet)
opts.warn: Red is gone by ~4s, ends on a daylit desert. Probably not.

groups.title: 18. The zoom-out, one satellite
groups.line: Your note: 'really like the zoom out… but we've got two satellites… recut… just with one satellite.'

opts.label: r2d: the satellite itself sweeps past the lens, then the fast pull-back
opts.warn: Closest to the v1 you liked, and the lens wipe is the same satellite now. A small satellite shows again from ~3s as we pull away; trim there if it reads as a second one.

opts.label: r2a: pull-back, the Milky Way opens up behind the Earth
opts.warn: No lens wipe. One satellite, gone by 3s. The widest, most beautiful ending.

opts.label: r2e: pull-back, satellite drifts across the planet's face
opts.warn: One satellite; no wipe.

opts.label: r2b: satellite leaves, then a clean pull-back to a dot
r2c: near twin of r2b
opts.warn: Almost the same as r2b.

groups.title: 20. Earth from the Moon: pick a still to animate
groups.line: Your note: 'it just doesn't look like Earth… a generic red splodge.' These are stills; nothing is animated until you pick.

opts.label: a: big red-lit Earth over the Moon
b: smaller, higher in the sky
c: half daylit (blue, Sahara), half red night
d: half daylit, half red, sitting on the horizon

groups.title: 1. Column out of the burning wreck
groups.line: Smoke wipe: Smoke engulfs the frame and clears to reveal the column right in front of us.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 2. Traffic light still changing
groups.line: Green to amber to red: The light changes on the beat while the robes march past underneath.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 3. The eye over the rooftops
groups.line: Lightning: A single lightning flash behind the mountain lights the whole valley of rooftops.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 4. Terraced street filled
groups.line: Lights go out: Street lamps go out one by one down the street toward us; only the red eyes remain.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 5. The stadium filled
groups.line: Floodlights bank off: The floodlight banks switch off in turn, leaving the red blocks glowing.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 6. The Welsh valley
groups.line: Fly down the valley: No grid here, so Veo flies the camera down the valley along the red river.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: Mid-clip a bright white building appears in the village for a moment; the valley shifts a little as the camera flies. Use the first ~4s.

groups.title: 7. Every field a parade ground
groups.line: Searchlights cross: The grid holds still; searchlights sweep across it.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 8. Down through the fleet
groups.line: Beams strobe on: The ships' beams switch on one after another down onto the fields.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 9. Ships circling the eye
groups.line: The storm turns: The ships orbit the eye like a weather system; lightning inside the cloud.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 10. Fleets above the clouds
groups.line: Rise up through the cloud: No grid: Veo rises the camera out of the cloud tops to reveal the fleet.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 11. A region through the fleet
groups.line: Beams sweep the region: The ships hold; beams sweep across the fields far below.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 12. The estuary bridges
groups.line: The columns cross: The robes stream across both bridges; tide and beams move.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 13. The eye's beam across 50 miles
groups.line: The beam fires: The beam shoots out from the eye across the land; ships ride along it.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: The beam is already firing at the first frame (no 'fire' moment); ships slide along it as asked.

groups.title: 14. London from 35,000 ft
groups.line: Cloud parts: Cloud drifts away to reveal the red city below.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 15. The motorways as red veins
groups.line: Rise to the curve: No grid: Veo rises the camera until the Earth's curve fills the top.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: Veo redraws halfway: the motorway map becomes Britain from orbit by 5s. That may be a gift (a ready-made bridge into frame 16) or a re-roll.

groups.title: 16. Past the solar wing onto red Britain
groups.line: The satellite drifts past: The satellite slides through frame; Britain turns slowly underneath.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: The satellite turns and grows, and its shape changes after ~5s. Use the first ~4s.

groups.title: 17. The satellite over red Europe
groups.line: Red light spreads: Europe's lights turn red, spreading across the land below the satellite.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: Backwards: patches of gold appear at 2–5s instead of going red, and the satellite tumbles and changes shape. Re-roll candidate.

groups.title: 18. The whole Earth, red, with the satellite
groups.line: Planet turns: The Earth turns slowly, more red land rolling into view.

opts.label: Keep

groups.title: 20. Past the Moon: a red Earth (last image)
groups.line: Moonrise reveal: The Moon's limb rises into frame from below to reveal the red Earth.

opts.label: Keep
opts.warn: The 'moonrise' move barely happens: it's a near-still hold. Fine for a fade-out ending; re-roll if you wanted the reveal.

sections.h: Orbit re-roll: three approaches per shot
sections.lede: Pick one per shot (or none). Labels say what each clip actually does on screen; Veo didn't always follow its brief.

groups.title: 17. The satellite over Europe
groups.line: Three tries: locked, time-lapse, circling.

opts.label: v1: satellite spins in place, a sun glint
opts.warn: The satellite changes shape as it turns; Europe stays red throughout.

opts.label: v2: camera drifts, the Earth's edge and daylight swing in
opts.warn: Satellite morphs; ends on a daylit Earth, not red.

opts.label: v3: satellite turns slowly, the curve of the Earth appears
opts.warn: Steadiest of the three for ~5s; then the satellite grows and changes.

groups.title: 18. The whole red Earth
groups.line: Three tries: lens wipe, fast pull-back, sunrise.

opts.label: v1: the satellite crosses the lens, then a fast pull-back to a tiny red Earth
opts.warn: My pick for the last zoom-out: the planet shrinks to a dot.

opts.label: v2: sunrise starburst over the edge
opts.warn: Lens flare hits the satellite at ~5s; clean.

opts.label: v3: sunrise, the glare holds
opts.warn: Like v2, with the sun held longer.

groups.title: 20. Past the Moon (last image)
groups.line: Three tries: pull back, rack focus, the last light.

opts.label: v1: the Moon's horizon shifts slowly
opts.warn: Very little motion; Veo barely moved the camera.

opts.label: v2: a still hold (the focus pull didn't happen)
opts.warn: Almost static.

opts.label: v3: a still hold, the red Earth
opts.warn: Almost static; the 'last gold light' isn't visible at this size.
